data.content_ref: inline:SRC_005 inherits from SRC_004 and SRC_002 because its piecewise-linear cumulative-digit function D(n) = 9×1 + 90×2 + (n−99)×3 depends on the identical arithmetic allocation (9 + 180 + 603) used in the other endpoints. The formula is an abstraction that reduces the stepwise allocation to a single invertible equation, yielding D(300) = 792. This inheritance is refuted if the cumulative function does not share mechanism with the arithmetic in SRC_004, or if the linear extrapolation beyond page 99 cannot be reduced to the exact digit counts (9, 180, 603) used in the other sources.
